stations.title: Imogen
stations.say: Why do forty labels say undefined?

stations.title: Price list
stations.text: Takes anything and gives back anything.

captions: Imogen printed forty labels at Oakhollow, and every one says undefined g.
Rafe's price list takes anything, so a call with a missing size goes through.
You give each function the types of what it takes and gives back.
Now a label without a size gets the usual one, and a bad call is refused.
Every call to the price list is checked before a label is printed.
